title: Sparkly toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='blockFace' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff6b6b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d94a4a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='blockTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff9a9a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff7b7b'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M20 18 L23 26 L31 29 L23 32 L20 40 L17 32 L9 29 L17 26 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 14 L82 20 L88 22 L82 24 L80 30 L78 24 L72 22 L78 20 Z'/>
    <path d='M86 70 L88 76 L94 78 L88 80 L86 86 L84 80 L78 78 L84 76 Z'/>
    <path d='M14 62 L16 68 L22 70 L16 72 L14 78 L12 72 L6 70 L12 68 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='46' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='52' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='86' r='2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- block top face -->
  <polygon points='30,45 50,33 70,45 50,57' fill='url(#blockTop)'/>

  <!-- block left face -->
  <polygon points='30,45 50,57 50,79 30,67' fill='url(#blockFace)'/>

  <!-- block right face -->
  <polygon points='50,57 70,45 70,67 50,79' fill='#b83a3a'/>

  <!-- stud on top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#ffb3b3'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#ffd6d6'/>

  <!-- letter A on the left face -->
  <g stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' fill='none'>
    <path d='M37 70 L40 59 L43 70'/>
    <path d='M38.2 65.5 L41.8 65.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
